record_type_quote: We conducted 2 replications of the Marley Hypothesis in a different institutional and regional context than prior studies.

targets.authors: Nelson, J. C., Adams, G., & Salter, P. S.
targets.title: The Marley Hypothesis: Denial of racism reflects ignorance of history.
targets.evidence_quote: In the 2 studies reported herein, we attempted to replicate prior research on the Marley Hypothesis, which argues that White Americans are more ignorant of historical instances of racism than Black Americans and that this ignorance of history mediates racial differences in perceptions of racism (Bonam et al., 2018, Study 1; Nelson et al., 2013).
targets.outcome_quote: Contrary to our predictions, Study 1 failed to replicate results of prior studies on the Marley Hypothesis.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly judge both replication studies failures of the central Marley mediation hypothesis; replicated ancillary findings do not alter this overall verdict.
